title: TREAT: A CODE LLMS TRUSTWORTHINESS / RE LIABILITY EVALUATION AND TESTING FRAMEWORK

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing Pass@1 accuracy of code generation and code reasoning tasks between Python and Java to identify systematic performance gaps and evaluation artifacts stemming from pre-training imbalances.

Comparing model performance rankings and accuracy across multiple paraphrased prompt variations for the same coding task to measure prompt sensitivity and mitigate the unreliability of single-prompt assessments.
Analyzing the style sensitivity, phrasing preference, and potential cross-family self-preference of LLM evaluators (e.g., GPT-4o) when grading generated code summaries and code reviews.
